To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the CEP engine can process real-time data in μs.
CEP is able to process real time data in μs and that the architecture is suitable to process data from multiple thousand of users.
the proposed conceptual architecture of an RTiG is able to process real time data from different sources in μs and that it is able to react on unexpected events.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a real-time capable intermodal route guide using CEP and EDA.
the development of a CEP based EDA for a RTiG which is able to process and analyze real-time data and react to unexpected events in real-time.
the design and implementation of an EDP-based intermodal traveler information system with a focus on real-time processing and the evaluation of the system’s scalability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our conceptual architecture and prototypical implementation of the RTiG is able to process data from different transportation modes in real-time and to provide travel assistance information to the user in case of unexpected events.
the proposed architecture and implementation are suitable for the application scenario and are able to deal with real-time data.
the proposed conceptual architecture is able to process data streams of real-time intermodal traveller information systems in real-time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our proposed conceptual architecture is suitable to be implemented in an RTiG and that CEP is able to process data in μs and therefore suitable to react on unexpected events in real-time.
our architecture is able to process real time data from multiple thousand user in μs.
the proposed architecture and implementation is a suitable solution to process real-time information for a real-time route guide.
The main takeaway from our work is that
our proposed architecture can be used to build a RTiG which can be used to assist travelers on their journey.
our proposed EDA is able to handle the requirements for an RTiG in terms of scalability, reliability, and performance.
CEP can be used as a main component of the architecture of an RTiG and is able to process the incoming data in real-time.
